notes:
A follow-up to 2.11.0 — profiles, collections polish, and a few conveniences.

- **Make it yours — profiles.** Click your account in the bottom-left and choose
  **Edit profile** to set a display name and a profile picture (paste a link or
  upload one). They replace your @username and initials across the app.

- **Collections, properly editable.** **Manage collection** now lets you change
  the name, description, poster and banner. In **Add media → Advanced options**
  you can send a new download straight into a collection (an existing one or a
  brand-new one). And inside a collection, right-click an episode to rename it,
  rewrite its description or swap its thumbnail — just for that collection, so the
  original show is left untouched.

- **Descriptions you can actually read.** Anime and TV shows now show their
  description at the top of the episode list instead of only on hover, and a
  collection shows what it's **made from** up top.

- **Episode editing gained a description** field alongside the name and thumbnail.

- **Refresh from anywhere.** A reload button now sits in the sidebar's server
  pill, so you can pull in new downloads from any screen.

- **A roomier sidebar** — larger text and icons, and a cleaner account area in
  the bottom corner.

- **Watched badge.** A series you've finished now gets a small green check on its
  cover (the old unwatched-count number is gone).

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
